result:
I added research lines (`ResearchLine`) as a new model that belongs to a research area. The enrollment form has a new "Linha de Pesquisa" field next to "Área de Concentração". I haven't run the migration, the app or the test suite, so none of it is tested. I only checked that the Ruby syntax of the enrollment model and helper is valid.

- **Model:** a research line has a name, a code and an area. Name and code must be unique. An area now has many lines and can't be deleted while it still has any.
- **Screens:** a new "Linhas de Pesquisa" controller and routes, a menu entry under Disciplinas, pt-BR labels, and the same permissions as research areas.
- **Enrollment:** a new optional `research_line` field. The line dropdown only lists lines of the selected area and refreshes when the area changes. An enrollment is rejected if its line doesn't belong to its area. I kept the existing area field, so current data doesn't need migrating.
- **Student view:** the line is shown next to the area in the student enrollment info.
- **Database:** a migration creates the `research_lines` table and adds `research_line_id` to enrollments. I edited `db/schema.rb` by hand to match, so it's worth regenerating by running the migration.
- **Tests:** I added a factory for research lines and left the existing tests untouched.

I picked the names `ResearchLine` and `research_line` myself, so rename them if you prefer something else.
